extDescription.message: Records video and audio, or audio only, from the current tab — including your voice from the microphone; command bar (Record / Stop / Save to…)

btnAudioTitle.message: Mute / unmute the tab audio in the recording

btnMicTitle.message: Mute / unmute your microphone in the recording

modeTitle.message: Video + audio, or only the tab's audio

micNeedsSetup.message: The microphone hasn't been enabled for Tab Recorder yet.

micUnavailable.message: 🎤 Microphone unavailable — recording tab audio only.

linkRecorderPageTitle.message: Open or go to the recording page

recorderAlert.message: ⚠️ Do not close this tab. It must stay open to record video and audio.

unsavedMessage.message: The last recording was not saved.

welcomeIntro.message: A tab's audio doesn't include your voice: in a meeting, the tab only plays the other people. To get your voice into recordings, Tab Recorder mixes your microphone with the tab audio.

welcomeOnce.message: Permission is requested only once, here. Click the button below and choose “Allow” in Chrome's prompt. Tip: recordings sound cleaner with headphones.

welcomeSkip.message: Rather not record your microphone? Uncheck “Include my voice” in the extension popup.

micStatusGranted.message: ✅ Microphone enabled. You can close this tab now.

micStatusPrompt.message: The microphone hasn't been enabled yet.

micStatusDismissed.message: The prompt was closed without an answer. Click “Enable microphone” again.

micStatusDenied.message: ⛔ The microphone is blocked for Tab Recorder. In “Open settings”, set Microphone to “Allow”, then come back to this tab.

micStatusNoDevice.message: No microphone found. Connect one and try again.
